book_color.001.decision: Removed the device asides and kept the choosing hand at the centre of the encounter. Both salon hands respond on both play modes. Native supplied-grab checks confirm propagation to both display hands and the production left/right material receivers; the latter were invisible fixtures without tracked pose. Loaded colours were restored and no save was requested.

book_color.002.decision: Shortened the catalogue of named stacks and reduced the DNA explanation to two sentences. Retained the bridge to later form grammar because that is an authored connection in this book. The plates carry the individual references; the reader’s invitation to find an unexpected detail remains.

book_color.003.decision: Named the crystal in its wire case and the collectible cube at the entrance as optional offers. Kept the welcome, mushrooms and rainbow as the room’s main encounter; the map has no gate requiring these pickups.

book_color.004.decision: Added a footnote connecting the colour/shape assignment to Kandinsky’s Bauhaus teaching and the building-game reference to Siedhoff-Buscher. Qualified the five-form stack as a loose reference rather than a reproduction of her set. Linked museum sources.

book_color.005.decision: Changed the mistaken sp score-display token to the intended s spawn token in Flashlight, Nails, Rainbow and Walls. Retained each authored cell; every other map value remains unchanged. Checked registry meaning and floor support in source. This repairs standalone-map loading; the museum controls its own arrival. No broad spawn sweep or headset arrival test is claimed.

book_color.006.decision: Replaced the internal probe-body name “the walker” with “you”. The statement still connects the retained floor support to the reader’s body.

book_color.007.decision: Replaced the internal ps07_kras_rainbow identifier with the physical change from a 72-centimetre study to a 6.2-metre column, in both the manuscript and the column plate. The source identifier, construction, dimensions and thirty stripes are unchanged.

book_color.008.decision: Corrected the sixteen-cube description: the row runs from one endpoint to the other, including those endpoint colours. The fourteen intervening samples no longer stand in for all sixteen cubes.

book_color.009.decision: Named Josef Albers and Homage to the Square; added a footnote to the series and Interaction of Color. Described the attention-to-surround exercise as drawing on his inquiry, without claiming that this wording or the procedural gallery is his original exercise.

book_color.010.decision: Removed the capture-rig height from the striped-column caption. The important comparison remains: stripes keep their places while the visitor’s view changes.

book_color.011.decision: Added the existing title “The choosing hand” above the salon’s opening question, matching the other Colour chapters.
